titel: We take John Turturro to the Cheesecake Factory

einzeiler: Nagin Farsad hosts with panelists Faith Saley, Hari Kondabolu, and guest John Turturro.
kurzfassung: Guest host Nagin Farsad leads the panel through news quizzes and games at the Studebaker Theater in Chicago. Actor John Turturro stops by to discuss his career and play a game about Hot Pockets. Listeners compete in phone trivia challenges for prizes.
stichpunkte: Nagin Farsad fills in as host for Peter Sagal at the Studebaker Theater in Chicago.
A listener named Mark plays Who's Alzo This Time and wins with a three-out-of-three score.
Airbnb updates its global rules to ban hosts from requiring guests to perform chores with significant effort.
Ellie from Minneapolis correctly identifies the true story in Bluff the Listener about people raising moss-covered bricks in China.
Actor John Turturro joins the show to talk about Severance and his new movie, then plays a game called Pickpocket Meet Hot Pocket.
Joanna from Boston wins the Listener Limerick Challenge with a perfect score.
Hari Kondabolu and Faith Saley tie for the win in the final Lightning Fill in the Blank round.

clips.text: The cost of holiday treats has surged dramatically over recent years, leaving families with fewer options for trick-or-treaters.

clips.hook: Raising bricks as pets in China
clips.text: People are adopting ordinary building blocks as low-maintenance companions that grow moss when sprayed with water.

clips.hook: Advice to take store-bought treats out of packaging
clips.text: A lifestyle website published a tip telling people to remove pre-made desserts from their boxes if they want to pass them off as homemade.

clips.hook: Traffic cameras catch hundreds of thousands of speeders
clips.text: A newly installed monitoring system in Washington state recorded an enormous number of speeding violations in its first month.

beschreibung:
This week, legendary actor John Turturro shows off his Christopher Walken impression and panelists Hari Kondabolu, Paula Poundstone, and Faith Salie talk Cheesecake Factory and learning to love a man made of wicker.
